children: Austin, Texas, United States, November 19th, 2026, FinanceWire

announced it has signed a general contracting agreement with Energy Resilience Partners LLC (“ERP”) to support two awarded U.S. Army microgrid contracts with a combined value of approximately $144.6 million, including options for increased capacity. ERP serves as prime contractor on both projects, with AZIO acting as general contractor for the approximately $45 million Fort Buchanan project in Puerto Rico and providing project-management support for the approximately $99.6 million, 15-megawatt project at the Lake City Army Ammunition Plant in Missouri. Each project is expected to take approximately three years once work begins, contingent upon delivery and acceptance of ERP’s performance and payment bonds.

The projects involve on-site power generation, battery storage and grid-independent operations, capabilities AZIO is also developing for its artificial intelligence (“AI”) infrastructure campuses through Project Atlas in Texas. The Fort Buchanan microgrid is designed to sustain operations independently of the commercial grid for up to 14 days. AZIO expects to recognize contract-based services revenue as work progresses, although the $144.6 million represents the value of ERP’s prime contracts rather than anticipated AZIO revenue. The company has not provided revenue or profit projections, and its compensation depends on ERP’s performance and payment under the Army contracts.

AZIO AI Holdings is a technology infrastructure company focused on developing, owning, and operating artificial intelligence data centers, enterprise GPU compute infrastructure, digital power solutions and digital asset mining operations.

The company operates an integrated AI infrastructure business encompassing AI data center development, the sale and distribution of enterprise GPU systems and server infrastructure, high-performance computing solutions, power hosting, and strategic technology investments, serving enterprise and institutional customers across domestic and international markets.

Through this diversified AI infrastructure strategy, the company is positioned to capitalize on the rapidly expanding global demand for AI infrastructure, compute capacity, digital power and next-generation AI technologies.
